meta.notes: Schedule (222 sets) hand-transcribed from Lost Lands' official Instagram set-times post, published 2026-09-09 (@lostlandsfestival) — see meta.sources. Map geometry (stylized, not surveyed). 'The Crater' is a pin dropped on the round stage structure in Google Maps satellite view on 2026-09-13 (39.9396873, -82.4052082; Google's own place label for that ring reads 'The Crater Stage - Lost Lands'). Every other '(approx.)' point was placed one of two ways. Inside the frame of a north-up Google Maps satellite screenshot (scale bar 200 ft = 147 px, so 0.41 m/px, registered on the Crater pin): the festival entrance on the road just south of the ring, first aid beside it, Chomp Steakhouse's pin in the north-east, Jurassic Glamping N at the white tent rows south-west of the ring, and the box office at the Rt 13 side of the entrance. 'Prehistoric Stage' and 'Wompy Woods' are pins dropped the same day: Prehistoric on the large spiky-roofed stage structure at the venue's own address (39.9387243, -82.4026215; the geocoded 7585 Kindle Rd point lands on it), Wompy Woods on the stage structure at the clearing's edge against the eastern woods, about 120 m south-east of Chomp Steakhouse (39.9407849, -82.4023979). 'Raptor Alley' is a fourth pin, on the stage structure in the clearing just south of I-70 and about 55 m north of Chomp Steakhouse (39.9423939, -82.4031989); it landed within 40 m of the position read from the official map. The official map had placed Wompy Woods about 200 m further east and south than its pin, so that map's east side is not to scale. 'Forest Stage' (39.9423736, -82.4050918; the structure in the trees just south of the I-70 ramp in the north-west) and 'Subsidia Stage' (39.9414507, -82.4055703; the structure in the clearing east of the west parking lot) are pins too, each within 70 m of the position read from the georeferenced screenshot. Every stage on the festival grounds is now a pin; The Grove, in the campground across Rt 13, is the only stage still approximate. Google imagery was used as a positional reference only, the same role as the illustrated map; no polygon was traced from it. 'Venue extent (approx.)' is carried over from the previous draft, which listed USGS NAIP and NHD in sources but did not record how it was drawn; its north edge agrees with the I-70 verge in the aerial to about 20 m, so it stays, still marked unverified. That draft's 'Wompy Woods treeline' polygon was dropped on 2026-09-16: same unrecorded provenance, its west edge agreed with the woods only to about 60 m, and a treeline is scenery rather than something anyone navigates by. The previous draft's 'Pond' polygon falls on the stage-material yard east of the ring in the aerial, where there is no water, so it is now null; the camping map shows a small pond near North Jurassic Glamping by the east tolls, which is where to look. The previous draft also had The Crater at the tunnel, Subsidia south-east of Prehistoric, Village Marketplace and an RV/tent camping polygon inside the festival grounds; all contradicted the official maps and were replaced. 'Campgrounds (W of Rt 13)' is left null rather than guessed: it spans several fields between Rt 13 and Licking Trails Rd and needs an aerial trace. Water refill and the landmarks (The Dino, Ferris Wheel) remain unplaced. Feature labels are kept within 32 bytes for Firefly's fp_feature_t. Schedule re-verified 2026-09-13 against the official 4-slide set-times graphics (Wed/Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun, published 2026-09-09): all 222 sets match on artist, stage, and start time; one artist spelling corrected (Smokland -> Smoakland, Wed Grove 19:10). End times transcribed 2026-09-13 from the official Lost Lands app schedule (screen recording, all 5 days): 221 of 222 sets have app-published end times; Mega B2B2B2B Pre-Party has no app listing so its end stays null. Label Takeover start corrected 20:00 -> 19:00 per the app (Thu 19:00-23:00). Friday Excision end corrected 00:10 -> 00:00 per the app (22:10-00:00). Events (56) added 2026-09-15 from a fan sweep of host and organiser announcements, each entry carrying its own source post; seven landmarks the hosts navigate by (triceratops, stegosaurus, T-Rex, velociraptor, Fire Dome, End Overdose, Discovery Center) added unplaced, and The Dino noted as Becky. 2026-09-16: 30 more events from the Sept 16 sweep (86 total); side-quest source links re-verified (28 resolve to the described accounts); the SideQuest Grid entry now cites the Aug 23 grid post and a separate entry carries the Sept 15 bonus-quest compilation. 2026-09-16: KandiWooks x Offbeat Luxury Travel goodie bag hunt added (87 events).
